title: SL1 Accident (1961)
summary: A long documentary-style film on the 1961 SL-1 reactor accident, where a control rod was withdrawn too far and the reactor went prompt-critical. The resulting steam explosion ejected control rods and shield plugs.
why: HN links it in nuclear safety and military reactor discussions as the full story of the only fatal US reactor accident.

quote.text: but that barely hints at just how eye-widening the whole saga was
